title: oenothera grisea
intro: Oenothera grisea, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial flowering plant in the family Onagraceae. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and relieving symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera grisea are attributed to its ability to modulate prostaglandins, which can help to alleviate pain and improve skin conditions like eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an omega-6 fatty acid, which has been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
